description: Faceted browse + tag editing over a vault library (Recipes/ + Components/ markdown notes). op='list' enumerates every asset and its tags; op='search' filters by free-text query and/or `tags_any`/`tags_all` set logic; op='tag' edits one asset's frontmatter tags (union or replace, always preserving '*'-pinned user tags); op='filter' returns assets matching a `license_tier` bucket (and optional SPDX `license` id). Pure vault I/O — no TouchDesigner bridge required. Requires TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

asset_path.description: Vault-relative path to one asset note (e.g. 'Recipes/feedback_tunnel.md'). Required for op='tag'.

folders.description: Vault subfolders to scan. Defaults to ['Recipes', 'Components'].

license.description: op='filter' (optional refinement): also require frontmatter `license` to equal this SPDX-id (case-insensitive).

license_tier.description: op='filter': return only assets whose frontmatter `license_tier` equals this bucket.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

op.description: Operation: 'tag' edits one asset; 'search'/'list' read across the library; 'filter' returns assets matching a license_tier (and optional license SPDX-id).

query.description: op='search': free-text substring matched against id/name/description/tags (case-insensitive).

replace.description: op='tag': when true, replace existing tags (kept '*'-pinned); when false, union.

tags.description: op='tag': tags to apply. Tags prefixed '*' are preserved as user-pinned.

tags_all.description: op='search': match assets that carry every one of these tags.

tags_any.description: op='search': match assets that carry at least one of these tags.

name: tag_and_search_library
title: Tag & search the vault library
